༄༅/ /rgya skad dang sngags don thor bu bod skad du bkrol ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgya skad dang sngags don thor bu bod skad du bkrol ba bzhugs/

na mo swa ra swa sti ye/ a ā i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ kṣa nas/ 'i bar ro/ sogs dang*/ gzhan yang*/ nas/ 'i bar te mtshon pa tsam zhig go/ /na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ 'dir rgya skad thor bu dang sngags don 'ga' zhig bod skad du bsgyur bar bya ste/ de yang*/ a mṛ ta ni bdud rtsi ste/ a ma la ni dri ma med/ /a sho ka ni mya ngan bral/ /a tsa la ni mi g.yo ba/ /a kṣo bhya ni mi bskyod pa/ /a mi ta ni dpag tu med/ /akṣa ra ni mi 'gyur ba/ /a su ra ni lha ma yin/ /'di 'dra'i a yig dgag tshig ste/ /a thā de nas a tra 'dir/ /a ti phul byung shin tu sogs/ /a bhi mngon pa a shwa rta/ /akṣa mig yin a hi nga*/ / a nu rjes su a dhwa dus/ /a lo ka ni snang gsal te/ /a laṅka ra rgyan yin la/ /a mu ka ni che ge mo'o/ /a nu ta ra bla na med/ /a mo gha ni don yod pa/ /anta mtha' yas ārtha don/ /a dhiṣṭhā na byin gyis brlabs/ /arha te ni dgra bcom pa/ /agni me ste aṣta brgyad/ /ārya 'phags pa ā ha smras/ /ā bha 'od yig ā dzñā bka'/ /ā ka sha ni nam mkha' ste/ /ā dar sha ni me long ngo*/ /ā sa na ni gdan gyi ming*/ /ā ka ra ni 'byung gnas ste/ /ā di dang po'i skad dod yin/ /i daṃ 'di ste ikṣa mtho/ /ind+ra dbang po indu grogs/ /uṣṇī ṣa ni gtsug tor la/ /u pa dhe ya mkhan po ste/ /u pa de sha man ngag go /u pa ya ni thabs kyi ming*/ /u pa si ka dge bsnyen te/ /u pa pā pa bsnyen gnas la/ /u pa saspa bsnyen par rdzogs/ /ṛ dwi rdzu 'phrul ṛ rdzu dang*/ /ṛ ṣi drang srong ṛ dwa 'byor/ /l̥ kha bris pa'i skad dod yin/ /e ka gcig yin e kha 'di/ / e waṃ 'di skad e hi byon/ /o gha chu klung o ṣa sman/ /aṃ ga yan lag ces bya ste/ /aṃ ga yan lag ces bya ste/

/aṃ ku sha ni lcags kyu la/ /aṃ gu ra ni myu gu'o/ /ga sa la kar byed pa ste/ /ka raṇḍa ni za ma tog /ka pā la ni thod pa'i ming*/ /ka ma la ni padma'o/ /ka ma ra ni chu srin ste/ /karma 'phrin las las su brjod/ /ka le ṇa ni dge ba'o/ /kā ra yi ge kā la nag /kā ya sku ste tshogs pa'o/ /kā ru ṇa ni snying rje ste/ /kā kha khwa ta kā ma 'dod/ /kā ri ka ni tshig le'ur byas/ /kī la phur bu kīrti grags/ /ku ru mdzod ces ku la rigs/ /ku mā ra ni gzhon nu ste/ /ku ku ra ni khyi yi ming*/ /kuṇḍa li ni 'khyil ba ste/ /kai la sha ni gangs can no/ /kṛ ya bya ba kṛṣṇa nag /kle sha ni nyon mongs so/ kha zhes bya ba nam mkha' ste/ kha na rko dang kha kha za/ khā hi zo zhig kho la zhwa/ khaṅga ral gri khe ṭa phub/ kha ṭwāṃ ka ni mkha' dbyug go /ga ṇa tshogs te gatstsha song*/ /ga ga nam mkha' ga ta gshegs/ /garbha snying po gan dha dri/ ga ru ḍa ni nam mkha' lding*/ /gan dha rba ni dri za'o/ /ka dza glang po'i skad dod yin/ /gu ṇa yon tan gu hya gsang*/ /gu ru bla ma gupta sbas/ /gā tha tshigs bcad girtī glu/ /gau ni ba lang go tra rigs/ /gra ha gdon yin gṛ taṃ khyim/ gha ṭa bum pa gho ṣa dbyangs/ /ghaṇḍa dril bu'i skad dod yin/ /tsarya spyod pa tsa la g.yo/ /tsakwa 'khor lo tsa tur bzhi/ /tsarma lpags pa tsand+ra zla/ /tsanṭa gtum po tsitta sems/ /tsinna bsam pa tsi tra mtshon/ /tsakṣu mig ste tsu ḍa gtsug /ci lu dge tshul zhes pa ste/ /tsau ra rkun po tsa tu mdzes/ tsa ra ṇa ni zhabs su grags/ /tsandha sdeb sbyor tstsha tra gdugs/ /tstsha ya grib gnon tstsinda gcod/ /dza ra rga ba dza la chu/ /dza ya dzi na rgyal pa'o/ /dza ṭa ral pa dzi hwa lce/ /dza na ka ni shes pa'o/ /dzā ti skye ba dza ṭi blun/ /dzā ya dra ba dzī wa srog /dzā la 'bar ba dzwa ri so/ /ṭakki 'dod pa ṭīkka 'grel/ /ḍā ka mkha' 'gro ḍam bha g.yung*/ /ḍa ma ru ni cang te'u'o/ /ta thā de bzhin ta tra der/

/ta pa tre ni gdugs kyi ming*/ /tant+ra zhes pa rgyud yin no/ /te dza gzi brjid tiṣṭha gnas/ /tri shu la ni rtse gsum ste/ /swā na gnas dang sthu laṃ sbom/ /sthi thi ra ni gnas brtan no/ /da sha bcu ste danda song*/ /daṇḍa dbyug pa da dha zho/ /duḥkha sdug bsngal dakṣi g.yas/ /de ba lha yin daṣta 'chi/ /dwi ba zhe sdang dwi ti gnyis/ /dā na sbyin pa dha nu gzhu/ /dharma chos te dhā tu khams/ /dhā ra ṇa gzungs dhu pe spos/ /dhā dza rgyal mtshan skad dod yin/ /na maḥphyag 'tshal na ba dgu/ /na ra mi ste nā ma ming*/ /nā tha mgon po nā ga klu/ /nā ya 'dren pa nā da sgra/ /nā bhi lte ba nī la sngo/ /pa ra gzhan te pa ti bdag /pa ri yongs su pa ṭu mkhas/ /paṇḍi ti ni mkhas pa ste/ /buṇḍa ri ka padma dkar/ /pu ru skyes bu pu tra bu/ /puṇya bsod nams yakṣi bya/ /pra ti so so pra bha 'od/ /pra dzi ta ni rab byung ste/ /pra ma tha ni dang po'o/ /pre ta yi dgas pā da zhabs/ /pā ṇi phyag na phā sha zhags/ /pā la skyong ba pā paṃ sdig /pā ra pha rol pūrba shar/ /pā traṃ lhung bzed pū dza mchod/ /po ta la ni gru 'dzin no/ /pha la 'bras bu pho ṭa bzod/ /spha ra ṇa ni 'phro ba'o/ /ba la stobs te ba hu mang*/ /badzra rdo rje bandha 'ching*/ /ba ru ṇā ni chu lha ste/ /baṃ sha kling bu bidya rig /bi shwa sna tshogs bighna na bgegs/ /biṣṇu khyab 'jug bi ra brtan/ /bi nā ya ni 'dul ba ste/ /bi nā ya ka log 'dren no/ /bi dzñā shes pa bi tā sla/ /bi ma la ni dri ma med/ /bi dza ya ni rnam par rgyal/ /buddha sangs rgyas bu dhi blo/ /bo dhi byang chub bṛkṣa shing*/ /bī ra dpa' bo byā ghu stag /byā ga ra ṇa lung ston pa/ /bha ga bcom ldan bha dra bzang*/ /bha ba dngos po bha kṣa za/ /bhikṣu dge slong bhā ṣa smra/ /bhu mi sa ste bhai ra 'jigs/ /bhau ma sa bla bhe da 'byed/ /bhu ta 'byung po'i skad dod yin/

/ma la dri ma ma ma bdag /ma ṇi nor bu ma ti blo/ /ma dhya dbus te ma hā che/ /ma dhu sbrang rtsi ma tra ma/ /maṃ sa sha ste mañdzu 'jam/ /manta sngags ste ma no yid/ /maṇḍa la ni dkyil 'khor ste/ /maṅga laṃ ni bkra shis so/ /mā la 'phreng ba mā ra sod/ /mu dra phyag rgya mu ni thub/ /muṣti khu tshur mu kha gdong*/ /mu ku ṭa ni cod pan he/ /muṅga ra ni tho ba yin/ /me gha sprin te mo ha rmongs/ /mokṣa thar ba mai tri byams/ /ya di gal te ya tha phyir/ /yakṣa gnod sbyin yu ga shig /yā na theg pa yo ga sbyor/ /ra tha shing rta rakṣa srungs/ /ratna rin chen rakta dmar/ /rā dza rgyal bo rā ga chags/ /rā hu la ni sgra gcan 'dzin/ /rākṣā srin po rū pa gzugs/ /ru tra drag po'i skad dod do/ /lakṣa ṇa ni mtshan nyid de/ /la li ta ni rol ba'o/ /lo hi ta ni dmar po ste/ /lo ka 'jig rten lo ha lugs/ /lū hi pa ni nya to pa/ /warma go cha wa rṇa seng*/ /wakka gsung ste wā ra 'khor/ /sha ra ṇa ni skyabs kyi ming*/ /sha ri ram ni sku gdung ngo*/ /shāsta ston pa shan ta zhi/ /shāst+ra bstan bcos shu la rtse/ /shī la tshul khrims shī ghwaṃ myur/ /sha sa na ni bstan pa yin/ /shwa ra dbang phyug shwa ta dkar/ /shwa na khyi ste shyā ma sngo/ /shra ma ṇa ni dge sbyong ste/ /shra wa ka ni nyan thos so/ /ṣaṭa ni drug ste ṣaṇḍa tshal/ /sarba thams cad sarpa sbrul/ /satya bden pa sapta bdun/ /saṅga dge 'dun sa ga chags/ /sa mya ka yang dag sa ma mnyam/ /saṃ pa ta ni 'khor ba ste/ /sa mā dzaḥni 'dus pa'o/ /si ta dkar bo sing ha seng*/ /siddha grub pa'i ming yin la/ /sa twa sems dpa' ma sems can no/ /sambha ra ni rgyas pa ste/ /sam ba ra ni bde mchog go /su kha bde ba su ra chang*/ /su ra ta ni shin tu dgyes/ /su ga ta ni bde bar gshegs/ /sam bho ga ni longs spyod rdzogs/ /sa mā dhi ni ting 'dzin no/ /sā ha sra ni stong phrag ste/ /sā ga ra ni rgya mtsho'o/

/surya nyi ma sū tra mdo/ /sa ma khya grangs med se na sde/ /sa manta ni kun nas ste/ /sa mu dra ni rgya mtsho'i ming*/ /swa sti bde legs swa ra dbyangs/ /swa bha wa ni rang bzhin no/ /ha ri 'phrog byed ha ya rta/ /ha sta lag pa ha na bsnun/ /hā sa bzhad pa he tu rgyu/ /hṛ da ya ni snying bo'o/ /kṣa ra 'gyur ba kṣa yi zad/ /kṣantai bzod pa kṣe tra zhing*/ /kṣo bha ya ni bskyod pa ste/ /de sogs gzhan yang shes par bya/ /gzhan yang*/ ai ka gcig yin dwi ti gnyis/ /tra ya gsum ste tsa tur bzhi/ /pañtsa lnga yin ṣaṭṭa drug /sa pta bdun no aṣta brgyad/ /na ba dgu ste da sha bcu/ /nga sha e ka bcu gcig la/ /dwi ta da sha bcu gnyis ste/ /tra yod sha la cu gsum mo/ /de bzhin gzhan la rigs 'gre sbyor/ /biṃ sha nyi shu/ biṃ sha ti ta maḥ nyi shu tham pa/ triṃ shaḥsum cu/ triṃ sha ti ta maḥsum cu tham pa/ sha ta ta maḥbargya tham/ sa ha sra ta maḥstong phrag /ko ṭi ta maḥbye ba phrag lakṣa ta maḥ'abum phrag go /buddha sangs rgyas/ dharma chos/ saṅga dge 'dun/ gu ru bla ma/ sa mā dā na/ yi dam/ ā tsarya slob dpon/ u pa dhya ya mkhan po/ shiṣya slob ma/ tsha tra grwa ba/ sra wa ka /nyan thos/ bhi kṣa dge slong*/ sthā bi ra/ gnas brtan/ bhikṣa ṇi/ dge slong ma/ bi nā ya/ 'dul ba/ sū tra mdo/ a bhi/ mngon pa/ saṃ ṭa ka /sde snod/ pra btsan gsung rab/ mant+wa/ sngags/ tamta rgyud/ kṛ ya tanta/ bya rgyud/ tsarya spyod/ yo ga rnal 'byor/ yo ga a nu dha ra rnal 'byor bla med/ de ba lha/ nā ga klu/ a u ra lha min/ yakṣa/ gnod sbyin/ rakṣa srin po/ gandha rba dri za/ ga ru ḍa nam mkha' lding*/ /kintsa ra mi'am ci/ mo ta ra ga lto 'phye chen po/ ma nu khya mi/ a ma nu ṣya mi ma yin/ ind+ra dbang po/ agne me lha/ ya mā gshin rje/ ner ṛ tye/ bden bral/ wa ru ṇā chu lha/ wā ya wa rlung lha/ ku be rā lus ngan/ ī sha nā dbang ldan/ pra hma tshangs pa/ surya nyi ma/ tsand+ra zla ba/

phri thi bī sa lha/ ha ri te 'phrog ma/ pu ru ṣa skyes pa/ st+ri bud med/ bi tra pha/ ma tra ma/ bu tra bu/ du hi tra bu mo/ ba dhū gna' ma/ bhārmā chung ma/ na dend+ra mi dbang*/ se ni sde pa/ karmi ra dpon mo/ ṭhakku ra nang so/ nadti ka dpon/ su hṛ ra mdza' bo/ seb g.yog /dā pa 'bangs/ sā mi rje bo/ pra pa ra ka rab 'byams pa/ da sha kṛtstsha dka' bcu ba/ gu ru utta ma/ bla ma mchog /sarba dzñā thams cad mkhyen pa/ bi bhu/ khyab bdag /pra bhu mnga' bdag /lo tsa ba legs sbyar ba/ sha wa ri ri khrod pa/ ma ho tta ra gong ma chen po/ yu ba rā dza rgyal tshab/ shir mgo /ke sha skra/ la lā ṭa dpral ba/ nai tra mig tsakṣu/ shro tra rna ba/ ghra ṇa snan si ka mu kha kha/ danta so/ dzi hwā lce/ kā ya lus/ grib mgrin pa/ ma no yid/ bi dzñā rnam shes/ bā hu dpung ba/ u ra brang*/ hasta/ lag pa/ uṅgu ṭha/ mthe bong*/ tardza na/ mdzub mo/ ma hya ma gung mo/ a nā miṅka/ ming med/ ka ni ṣṭha mthe'u chung*/ ka ṭi rked pa/ dza nu pus mo/ dza gha byin pa/ pā da rkang pa'am zhabs/ sā yu rkub/ se la rlig pa/ ling ga rtags sam mje/ ladtha mo mtshan/ yo ni */ masta ka /klad pa/ ru dhi ra khrag shu tra khu ba/ lwast+ra gos/ mo dza lham/ pusta ka dpe cha/ tsī ba ra chos gos/ ni brda ni gding ba/ khaḍga ral gri/ ā sa na gdan/ kha ṭwa gri/ ma si snag tsha/ li kha ni myu gu /kā ka ta sho gu /phe ta phub/ shū la mdung*/ sha ra mda'/ dha nu gzhu/ dhu sya dngul/ su wa rṇa gser/ be ro tsa g.yu/ mukte ka mu tig /pra bā la byi ru/ nī la mu men nam sngo/ rā mra zangs/ kaṃ pa mkhar ba/ shaṃ kha dung*/ lo ha lcags/ gā ra khang ba/ kṣe ṭa zhing*/ dhā na nor/ bā su/ a shwa rta/ bri mar mdzo/ be sa ra dre'u/ tsa ma ra g.yag /e ḍa lug tstsha ṛ ra/ mṛ ga ri dwags/ na ba nī ta mar gsar/ ka ṭo ta thung*/ sa tu tsam pa/ su ra'am la dya chang*/ gu ḍa 'o ma/ dza ba nas/ mā ṣa sran ma/ go dhu ma gro/ ka ṣā bā na ja/ pha la bzang*/ nind+ra ngan/ su kha bde/

sharma skyid/ mā ya mū le/ sku drung du/ pra ta spyan sngar/ shro tro snyan du/ pā ṇau phyag tu/ pra shaḥ zhu ba/ sa ma rmi taṃḥ phul ba/ pra ṣa taṃ/ springs pa/ ā sha tyai/ ngo mtshar/ attha ta/ rmad byung*/ utta ma mchog pra rab ba ra/ sambṛ ta kun rdzob/ pa ra martha don dam/ khe yartha drang don/ ni tārtha nges don/ dharmā ta chos nyid/ dhā tu dbyings/ shū n+ya tā stong nyid/ u dā ra rgya che ba/ ru ṣa ba tyaṃḥ dga' ldan du/ su kha ba tīḥ bde ba can du/ de ba bhū mi lha sa/ de baḥlha/ de bau lha dag de bāḥlha rnams/ de baṃ lha la/ de bau lha dag la/ de wan lha rnams la/ de ben lha yis/ de bā bhyaṃ lha dag gis/ de baiḥlha rnams kyis/ de bā ya lha'i ched/ de bā bhyaṃ lha dag gi ched/ de'i bhyaḥ lha rnams kyi ched/ de bā ta lha las/ de bā bhyaṃ lha dag las/ de be bhyaḥlha rnams las/ de ba sya lha'i/ de ba yo lha dag gam/ de bā naṃ lha rnams kyi/ de pe lha la/ de bi yoḥlha dag la/ de ba ṣu lha rnams la/ hai de ba kye lha/ he de ba kye lha dag /he de bāḥkye lha rnams so/ /gzhan yang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu nā ye swāhā/ tadya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye bhai ṣa dzye ma hā bhai ṣa dzye rā dzā sa mudga te swāhā/ tadya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṅga te bo dhi swāhā/ a kṣo bhyaḥ/ a mi tā bhā ya/ na mo su ma ti kīrti la blo bzang grags pa la 'dud/ 'di lta ste/ thub pa thub pa thub pa chen po la gzhi chugs/ sman pa sman pa sman pa chen po sman pa'i rgyal po yang dag par 'phags te 'gro ma/ song ma song ma pha rol tu yang dag par song ma byang chub/ mi 'khrugs pa/ 'od dpag med/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃḥ oṃ wā kyai daṃ na maḥ oṃ ārya mai tri swā hā/ na mo lo ke shwa ya/ a ba lo ke te/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūṃ/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/

oṃ mā rī tsyai swā hā/ 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i blo/ ngag gi dbang phyug /ngag stsol la 'dud/ 'phags pa byams pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la 'dud/ spyan ras gzigs/ kyai nor bu padma/ phyag na rdo rje/ gtum po 'jigs byed chen po/ sgrol ma sdug bsngal las sgrol ma/ 'od zer can ma/ oṃ bi shā tsi parṇa sha wa ri sarba dzwa ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi dha di badzri ṇai/ ma hā pra te sa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ padmo ṣṇī ṣa bi ma le hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na su bi ni shtsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ sha za ri khrod lo ma can rims thams cad zhi ba'i ched du/ nor bu 'dzin pa rdo rje can/ so sor 'brang ba chen mo/ pad ma gtsug tor dri med ma/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas che ded ye shes dpag arha te sa n+ya gaṃ bud dhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā puṇye/ a pa ri mi ta pu ṇye/ a pa ri mi ta bu ṇye dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi ta/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ri pa ri shudha dharma te/ ga ga na sa mud ga te swa bhā wa bi shud dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ bsod nams gnyis bsod nams chen mo bsod nams dpag med pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag med nye bar bsags ma/ 'du byed thams cad yongs su dag pa'i chos nyid ma nam mkhar 'phags ma rang bzhin rnam dag ma tshul chen pos yongs su bskor ma/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi ji wanti ye swā hā/ 'chi ba med pa'i srog ldan ma la/ na mo pi ba shye ne/ rnam gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shi khe ne bi shwa bhu dze ka ku tstshantā ka na ka mu ne kā shya pā ya/ gtsug tor can thams cad skyob log par dad sel gser thub 'od srung la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/

oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni to ni/ tra sa ni ta sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa ri pā ri ṇi me sarba sa twa nañtsa swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba du rga te pa ri sho dha na rā dzā dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa rnams sdig pa rnams/ sregs sregs/ chod chod/ skrag par gyis gnyis/ so sor choms gnyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad/ phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ bud dha ya/ tadya thā/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne shuddhe bi shuddhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzwa sa twa dwe no pa tiṣṭha/ d-i ḍho me bha wa bau/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ sbyong ma sbyong ma/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ma/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ma gzhi tshugs/ rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig /rjes su skyong ba/ rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis nye bar gnas/ bdag la brtan par mdzod/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod/ su po ṣyo me bha ba/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ a nu rakto me bha ba/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ sarba sid dhi me pra yatstsha/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ/ shre yaḥ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa/ badzraṃ bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ i daṃ gu ru ratna maṇḍal kaṃ ni rya ta yā mi las thams cad bdag sems la/ dge legs su mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rjer bdag ma 'dor/ rdo rje can mdzod/ dam tshigs sems dpa' chen po/

rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bsnun bsnun/ bla ma rin po che dang dkyil 'khor ba la 'di dbul bar bgyi'o oṃ ye dharmā he du pra bha wa/ sogs ni/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ /zhes sogs yin no/ /oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ oṃ badzra a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañtsa ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje mes bsnun sregs tshos tshom thul zhes pa'o/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpa nna twāta/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho ྅haṃ/ na massarba ta thā ga te bhyo/ bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇi he ma/ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛ hṇa daṃ pa linte swā hā/ ṭakki dza/ 'dod pa/ a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa nga'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sgo sna tshogs nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa thams cad du nam mkhar 'phags shing khyab pa 'di nam mkha'i dbyings su/ gtor ma 'di zung*/ na massarba ta thā ga ta/ a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun nas gzigs la 'dud/ yang dag rgyas yang dag rgyas pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur ba'i dam tshig dpal gyi phyir du/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal bo g.yo ba g.yo ba/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya swā hā/ rnam thos sras la/ bai shra ma ṇā/ ngal sos bo/ /dzambha la dza lend+ra/ rmugs 'dzin dbang bo/ /bā su dha ri/ nor rgyun ma/ pūrṇa bha dra/ gang ba bzang bo/ ma ṇi bha dra/ nor bu bzang bo/ nas pañtsi ka /lnga rtsen/ pi tsi kuṇḍa li/ 'jam po 'khyil ba/ 'i bar ro/ /na mo bhruṃ ā urdzñā na hrīḥ ā ro li ka hūṃ hrīḥ tshe dang ye shes 'khor ba 'jig /a pa ri mi ta ā yu rdzñā na/

tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ bai ro tsa na ā yurdzñā na sid dhi sa ma ye/ rnam par snang mdzad tshe dang ye shes dngos grub dam tshig la/ badzra/ rdo rje/ ratna/ rin chen/ padma/ pad ma/ karmā/ las/ sarba lo ki te/ kun gzigs/ gu ṇa/ yon tan/ i tsa la/ mi g.yo ba'o/ /oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ā wa ra ṇā bi sho dha na ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ thams cad rig pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong bsnun/ bud dha lo tsa ni/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma kī/ bdag gi ma/ paṇḍa ri/ gos dkar mo/ tā re/ sgrol ma/ badzra sa twa/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ nas badzra ghaṇḍa/ rdo rje dril bu ste 'bebs pa'o/ /kalpa bha dra/ bskal bzang*/ shra wa ka /nyan thos/ pra dyaka /rang rgyal/ kro dha/ khro bo/ lo ka /'jig rten pa'o/ /ya ma rā dzā ni/ gshin rje'i rgyal bo/ sa ni de/ do ni chos/ me ni bdag la/ ya ni gang*/ ya me ni/ gshin rje mo/ do ni chos/ ru ṇa dgra/ yo da ya ni/ mi 'byung bar/ ya ni/ gang zhig /yo ni/ skye gnas/ rā ya ni/ rten/ kṣe ya ni/ zad byed/ ya kṣe ni/ gnod sbyin mo/ yatstsha ni/ gang yang*/ nī ra ma ya ni/ 'khrul bar gyis shig pa'o/ /de yang*/ gshin rje'i rgyal bo de chos bdag la gang*/ /gshin rje mo chos dgra yang mi 'byung bar/ / gang zhig skye gnas rten ni zad byed pa/ /gnod sbyin mo ni gang yang 'khrul bar gyis/ /zhes pa ste/ don 'gyur byas na mi 'dra ba zhig 'byung ngo*/ / hrīḥṇḍī'i don no/ /'phrog byed mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal can la/ ya mānta ka ne/ gshin rje mthar byed/ badzra betta li ā gatstsha ā gatstsha ni/ rdo rje ro langs tshur byon tshur byon/ dzaṃ na ji ka /nas mo ha ra ti/ 'i bar ni/ rgyal bas rgyal/ rin chen 'chang*/ padma 'chang*/ shes rab 'chang*/ tho ba 'chang*/ dbyug pa 'chang*/ padma 'chang*/ ral gri 'chang*/ gti mug dga' ma/ nas/ rdo rje dga' ma'o/ /oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dpal khrag 'thung*/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba raṃ/

mkha' 'gro dra ba sdom/ badzra bai ro tsa nī/ rdo rje rnam par mdzad/ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni/ ye badzra warṇa nī ye/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje rigs ldan ma/ badzra wā ra hi/ rdo rje phag mo/ ḍā ki nī/ nas/ ya ma ma tha nī'i bar ni/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ nas/ gshin rje mche ba ma/ gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar rnams so/ /bha ga wa te bī rai shā ya/ nas/ wa pu ṣā ya'i bar ni/ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la/ nas/ sku chen dung kha bgegs mthar mdzad la'i bar ro/ /oṃ badzra dhṛka jin dzika /nas/ sum bha rā dza'i bar ni/ rdo rje 'chang ngam rdo rje 'dzin/ rgyal bas rgyal lam/ don 'gyur 'khor lo 'dzin/ rin chen 'dzin/ 'khor ba 'jig gam/ don 'gyur padma 'dzin/ ral gri 'dzin nam/ shes rab 'dzin no/ /gti mug dga' ma/ de bzhin du/ zhe sdang*/ 'dod chags/ rdo rje dga' ma'o/ / gzugs rdo rje ma/ nas/ gnod mdzes rgyal bo'i bar ro/ /'on kyang padma nna kṛ ta ni/ padma mthar byed ces pa yin na'ang don 'gyur la rta mgrin no/ /suṃ bha nges par 'dul ba/ ni suṃ bha ma lus par nges par 'dul ba/ gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa/ zung zung*/ gṛ hṇa pa ya gṛ hṇa pa ya/ 'dzin chu chu gnyis/ a na ya ho/ khug cig /he bha ga wan/ kye bcom ldan 'das/ badd+ri dra dza/ rig pa'i rgyal po/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ dpal nag po chen po/ shā sa na u pa ta ro ṇa/ bstan pa la phan pa nye bar bsgrub pa/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a laṃ/ 'di phyi ma min pa'i dus 'di dang i di ratna tra yā ya/ 'dir dkon mchog gsum la/ a pi kā ri ṇaṃ/ gnod par byed pa/ ya de pra tī dzñā sma ra si ta da/ gal te byung na dam bca' dran par gyis la de'i tshe/ i daṃ duṣtaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gdug pa can 'di zo zo zo zhig zo zhig /ma ra ma ra/ sod ma gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ zung zung*/ bandha bandha/ chings chings/ ha na ha na/ bsnun bsnun/ da ha da ha/ sregs sregs/ pa tsa pa tsa/ tshos tshos/

de na mi ke na/ nyi ma gcig gis/ mā ra ya/ sod/ hūṃ phaṭa/ bi ghan/ bgegs/ bi na ya ka / log 'dren/ kā la rlung nag po'i gzugs/ kā la de wi/ lha mo nag mo/ shrī de bi/ dpal lha/ pra ṇa atma kī ru pu ru lo hi ta sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya/ skyes bu srog bdag dmar bo dgra thams cad sod/ dharma pā la/ chos skyong*/ mahā rā dza/ rgyal bo chen po da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas/ bha wantu/ dge'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ bkra shis so/ /ces pa 'di yang dka' bcu ba 'jam dbyangs sbyin pas bskul ba ltar shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis bsgrigs pa'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ rgya skad dang sngags don thor bu bod skad du bkrol ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 238-- PAGE 237-- PAGE 225-
